flags: The cache contains no designating-agency or tourism account of the Lassen Scenic Byway’s qualities, and does not independently confirm the catalog’s National Forest Scenic Byway designation or 171.5-mile total. Used the documented relationship to the Volcanic Legacy All-American Road without transferring that designation to the park highway alone.
Winter closure is supported as a general seasonal pattern only. The cache has no current park or road-manager bulletin confirming October 2026 access; checked records the requested cache-review date.

Current claims were broadly supported. Corrected the lake-loop summary to include the eastward SR 36 leg to SR 44 west of Susanville before returning northwest. The historical Sulphur Works entrance station is not asserted to survive.
The source excludes SR 36 through Mineral from the official byway; the overview says the road joins SR 36 east of Mineral. Park highway construction dates are not dates for the whole Lassen loop.
Moment order follows the current southbound park traversal, then Chester, consistent with the strip’s Mineral-before-Chester progression. Old Station is the narrative starting point on the loop.
